# KM Afaq

> KM Afaq is a bilingual (English and Urdu) site with practical AI automation, web development and technology guides, plus jobs, a business directory, AI tool listings, digital products and services.

Canonical site: https://kmafaq.online. Primary languages: English (en) and Urdu (ur). Articles are written by KM Afaq.

## Content

- [Blog](https://kmafaq.online/blog): All published articles on AI, technology and online earning, in English and Urdu.
- [English Blog](https://kmafaq.online/blog/english): English-language articles and tutorials.
- [Urdu Blog](https://kmafaq.online/blog/urdu): Urdu-language articles and tutorials.
- [RSS feed](https://kmafaq.online/rss.xml): Latest articles in RSS 2.0 format.

## Services and resources

- [Services](https://kmafaq.online/services): AI automation, web development and tech consulting services.
- [AI Tools](https://kmafaq.online/tools): Directory of AI tools.
- [Jobs](https://kmafaq.online/jobs): Job and freelance listings.
- [Business Directory](https://kmafaq.online/business): Business listings.
- [Digital Store](https://kmafaq.online/shop): Digital products.
- [Pricing](https://kmafaq.online/pricing): Pricing and advertising options.

## About

- [About](https://kmafaq.online/about): Who writes KM Afaq and what it covers.
- [Contact](https://kmafaq.online/contact): How to get in touch.

## Optional

- [XML sitemap](https://kmafaq.online/sitemap.xml): Every public URL.
